_comment: Interview knowledge the DV-110 field_config cannot express. DV-110 prints "The person asking for a restraining order must complete 1, 2, and 3 only. The court will complete the rest of this form", so every field the court fills is marked courtUse in the field config and never becomes a question. Most of what is left repeats DV-100 and is renamed to DV-100's field by dv-packet-connections.json, so it is asked once; the questions below are the ones DV-110 asks that no other form does - the CLETS description of the restrained person that police need to enforce the order.
